notes: Work Order Compliance Verifier · Trust Domain D · Phase 8 v0.1.6 · introduced in v0.1.6 hardening. Bounded: checks CONSTRAINT COMPLIANCE against Work Order + Capability Manifest. Does NOT judge code quality.

verifier_checks.asks: every file in AUTHORITATIVE_DIFF_BUNDLE is within write_root and matches permitted_mutation_types
every process invocation in event log matches an allowed_processes entry
every required acceptance test declared in Work Order was actually executed AND its outcome recorded
mechanically-verifiable Work Order constraints hold (e.g. api-surface hash preserved · lockfile hash unchanged · specific file patterns retained)
every NEX1 action taken under PROPOSED_INTERPRETATION has a matching AUTHORITY_LAYER_DECISION_ID · per P-O
iteration_count · cpu_ms · memory_bytes · wall_ms · total_write_bytes · process_count stayed within Capability Manifest resource_limits

verdicts_permitted.CONSTRAINT_VIOLATED: one or more explicit_constraints_satisfied checks failed
verdicts_permitted.INTERPRETATION_AUTHORITY_EXCEEDED: NEX1 action taken under PROPOSED_INTERPRETATION without matching authority decision
verdicts_permitted.REQUIRED_TEST_NOT_EXECUTED: declared acceptance test did not execute · P-M applies · no marketing claim
verdicts_permitted.REQUIRED_DECISION_NOT_OBTAINED: DECISION_REQUEST unresolved before proceeding · P-O applies
verdicts_permitted.FILE_OUT_OF_SCOPE: mutation outside write_root · MASTER_AUTHORITY_ELEVATION_ATTEMPT elsewhere in log

verdict_fields: check_results[] · one per verifier_check · pass|fail · detail
cited_evidence_ids[] · Broker events · Observer bundle · NEX1 proposal (advisory)
signature · Ed25519 by Compliance Verifier private key · key_id + key_version
invariants: Verifier does NOT judge code quality · aesthetics · algorithm optimality · style
Verifier only performs mechanical constraint checks against Work Order + Capability Manifest
Verifier has ZERO write authority · reads only
Verifier's Ed25519 private key is separate from Broker's and Observer's · never exchanged
Verifier verdict routes through Evidence Validation as AuthoritativeEvidenceRecord
NEX2/NEX3 arbitrate over Verifier verdict alongside AUTHORITATIVE_DIFF_BUNDLE
